key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Follow the system style, or force a light or dark one.

key.name: workspace-color
key.description: Color of the area around the picture as #rrggbb. Empty uses the theme's gray.

key.name: show-frame-time
key.summary: Show the frame time in the status bar

key.name: default-width
key.summary: Width of a new picture, in pixels

key.name: default-height
key.summary: Height of a new picture, in pixels

key.name: default-background
key.summary: Background color of a new picture as #rrggbb

key.name: default-font
key.summary: Text tool font, as a Pango description

key.name: text-opaque
key.summary: Text starts with an opaque background

key.name: line-width
key.summary: Line width of Line, Curve and the shape tools

key.name: undo-limit-mb
key.summary: Size of the undo history, in megabytes
key.description: The newest 64 MB stay in memory and older steps are kept in a temporary file. Past this size the oldest steps are forgotten.

key.name: palette
key.description: The 28 palette colors as #rrggbb, top row first. Empty means the classic palette.
